name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new pipeline, metric, or capability
title: ''
labels: enhancement
---

## What you would like

A clear description of the idea. If it is a new model or dataset, say which one and why it
adds something the four existing pipelines do not already cover.

## Why it is worth doing

The problem it solves or the question it would answer.

## How you imagine it working

A rough sketch is fine. For a new pipeline, that usually means a loader, a model builder,
a conversion path, and a config.
